faqs.a:
All street access points shall be designed in accordance with the standard specifications
               of the city, except as required or approved by the traffic engineer and the city engineer.
               Situations where a different treatment may be required or approved may include (but
               are not necessarily limited to) provision of larger radii for trucks, additional width
               to provide for additional exit lanes or unusual site planning conditions.
(Code 1981, § 30-137; Ord. No. 1544, § 3, 3-19-1979)
